entities.summary: Ella Waweya, known widely as "Captain Ella", is an Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officer who holds the rank of lieutenant colonel. She is the highest-ranking Muslim Arab woman in the IDF and is currently serving as the Spokesperson for the IDF's Arabic media, heading the Arabic communications department.
